newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau inflation rises 4.6 percent in February.
newsitem.headline: Macau inflation rises 4.6 percent in February.

text.p: Macau's composite consumer price index (CCPI) rose 4.6 percent in February from the same month in 1996, the Portuguese-run enclave's Census and Statistics Department said on Monday.
The CCPI, which averages expenditure patterns of various income groups while excluding housing rents, rose 1.1 percentage points between January and February, it said.
The inflation rate as measured by CCPI stood at 4.8 percent last year against 8.6 percent in 1995.
